rules.description: Spotted an issue (security gap, missing test, bad code, duplication, stale idiom) — never ignore: small→fix inline, bigger→ask, many→follow-up PR

rules.description: Production/infra/security/external-system output — blast radius + rollback; Hard-Floor never autonomous

rules.description: Before features or architectural changes — validate against existing code, challenge weak requirements

rules.description: Before executing a complex plan — ask 'am I solving the right problem?' and pause for confirmation

rules.description: Laravel language files, translations, i18n, lang/de, lang/en, __() helper, localization

rules.description: Legal-pack output (contract/NDA/DPA review, triage) — never a final legal call; attorney-review line; EU/DE-only

rules.description: No placeholder prose in generated code/UI — no truncation shorthands; on budget overflow emit a clean PAUSED breakpoint
